prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1405; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Katy, Texas, and began a left turn when Driver 2 struck the side of the vehicle. Both drivers stated that the collision occurred as described, and independent witnesses at the scene gave consistent accounts that matched Driver 1's version of events. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side that lines up with the direction and force of the impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle was reported or observed. The Passenger was present in the vehicle at the time of impact, which was confirmed by the responding officers and by the witnesses. Driver 1 reported a knee injury, and the nature of that injury is consistent with the type and force of the collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle. Officers noted no citations at the scene and recorded the locations of both vehicles as they came to rest.
